title: Terracotta desk speaker: unbox to hero, one take
brief: 30-second ad for a small matte terracotta desk speaker, unboxed on a desk, ending on a hero shot.

subject.name: desk speaker
subject.spec: A small matte terracotta desk speaker shaped like a squat rounded block, about the size of a coffee mug, smooth surface with no visible seams, one thin white light bar across the lower front face. No text, no logo, no buttons, no fabric, no grille.
rules: no text or logos on the product
same shape, size and colour in every frame

camera: Locked in the keyframe 1 position from 0 to 17 s, then one slow push-in that lowers to desk height and comes to rest on keyframe 4 at 30 s.

must_be_true: closed plain kraft box, lid on, slightly left of centre on a walnut desk
window at the left edge, soft morning light from the left
empty desk space to the right of the box
small plant softly out of focus, back right
camera at chest height, looking slightly down, three-quarter angle
no hands, no people, no text
keyframes.image_prompt: Photorealistic 16:9 photo. A closed plain kraft-paper box with no printing, lid on, sits slightly left of center on a walnut desk. A window at the left edge of the frame lets in soft morning light from the left. Empty desk space to the right of the box. A small green plant softly out of focus in the back right. Camera at chest height, looking slightly down, three-quarter angle. No text, no logos, no people, no hands.

product_still_prompt: Product photo on a plain light grey background, soft studio light. A small matte terracotta desk speaker shaped like a squat rounded block, about the size of a coffee mug, smooth surface with no visible seams, one thin white light bar across the lower front face. No text, no logo, no buttons, no fabric, no grille.
frames_prompt:
One continuous shot for the full 30 seconds. No cuts, no angle changes, no scene changes.
@image_1 is the first frame and @image_4 is the last frame. The camera stays locked in the @image_1 position until 17s, then makes one slow, smooth push-in that lowers to desk height and comes to rest exactly on @image_4 at 30s.
The product is a small matte terracotta desk speaker, a squat rounded block with a smooth surface with no visible seams, no buttons, no fabric, one thin white light bar on the front, no text or logo. Its shape, size and color stay exactly the same throughout.
0-7s: A closed kraft box sits on a walnut desk in soft morning light from the window on the left. Two hands enter from the bottom of the frame, lift the lid straight up, lay it flat beside the box and leave the frame.
8s: matches @image_2, the speaker sits in white tissue in the open box, its light bar off.
9-16s: The hands come back, lift the speaker out, stand it on the desk in front of and to the right of the box, and leave the frame.
16-17s: The light bar fades on. 17s matches @image_3.
17-30s: The camera slowly pushes in and lowers toward the speaker while the light bar pulses gently. The box, lid and window fall softly out of focus. The camera stops on @image_4.
Sound: paper rustle, a soft chime when the light bar comes on, quiet room tone. No music, no voice, no subtitles.

edit.reference_image_prompt: Change only the speaker's body color from matte terracotta to matte black, same matte finish, no new reflections. The light bar stays glowing soft white. Keep the brightness and color of the room exactly the same. Change nothing else.
edit.prompt:
Edit @video_1. Change only the speaker's body color: everywhere the speaker appears, from the moment it is revealed in the tissue paper to the last frame, it becomes matte black like the speaker in @image_1, same matte finish, same shape, size, position and movement. The light bar stays white and comes on at the same moment.
Keep unchanged: the kraft box and lid, the white tissue paper, the hands, the walnut desk, the plant, the window light and the overall brightness and color of the room, the camera move and the timing.

consistency_checklist: All four keyframes are PNG, the same pixel size, 16:9
Same desk grain, window, plant and light direction in all four
Box, lid and tissue present and in the same place in kf2, kf3 and kf4
Light bar off in kf2, on in kf3 and kf4
Speaker shape, size and colour identical in kf2, kf3 and kf4
No hands or people in any keyframe
kf1, kf2 and kf3 share one camera position; only kf4 differs (the planned push-in)
Empty desk on the right in kf1, speaker right of centre in kf3 so the push-in lands on kf4
No text, logos or stray objects anywhere
Prompt beats name the keyframes in upload order: @image_2 at 8s, @image_3 at 17s, @image_4 at 30s
